'''Luci''' is the assistant to [[Ronde Macura]], a dressmaker in the village of [[Mardecin]], a small village in [[Amadicia]]. 

== Appearance ==
She is young and thin and has curly dark hair.

== Activities ==
Following orders from Ronde, she brews a batch of [[Forkroot]] tea to serve to [[Nynaeve]] and [[Elayne]] who came in to the shop to receive a message. Luci brews the tea and Nynaeve and Elayne collapse at the table.{{ref/book|5|9}}
